issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Stock.findStockIngredient: the problem statement UML and the solution implementation declare a single-parameter method Stock.findStockIngredient(String name), but the template's Stock class declares Stock.findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) (two parameters). This discrepancy means calls shown in the specification/solution (e.g., stock.findStockIngredient(name)) will not compile against the template API and will confuse students about which signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template API with the problem statement and solution. Either (1) change the template method signature to public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) and implement the desired lookup behavior, or (2) add an overload public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) that delegates to the existing findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) (for example, defaulting caseSensitive to false or true). This preserves the intended UML/solution calls (stock.findStockIngredient(name)) and avoids compilation errors for students following the specification.
